phase: Same 16 known development contexts x one candidate x two new seeds = 32. Explicit arrival/preparation versus committed start. No new policy, no confirmation reuse.
primary: Complete matrix, at least 95% representation/temporal validity, no request failures; all known mandatory time and closure checks pass in both seeds. Manually inspect every whole-day action sequence. Do not infer macro validity.
selection: Choose lower generated-token cost only among eligible modes. This is restricted-action architecture. Representation and prose-fabrication prevention are by construction, not unaided model factuality. No consumption-effect claim.
limitations: Finite activity vocabulary with explicit provider extensions; does not model all possible human activities.
Meals at home do not certify inventory availability. Paid service prices and purchases are checked in a separate contract.
Adjacent commute timing is not full routing.
No full-day consumption completeness or causal external validation from a schedule pass.
